estimates.rationale: Foundational persisting slice: new stock entity + unique (sku,location) constraint, repository/service/boundary layers, and a full E2E UI form with empty state, validation, and index/detail render.
Builds on FP1's row; adds one adjust operation with a non-negative check and an optimistic in-place UI update — narrow scope on existing layers.
New supplier-attributed inbound event that increments stock: added domain concept, receipt form + confirmation, and cross-entity write on top of the stock model.
Outbound pick with write-time overcommit enforcement (R2); transactional draw-down plus inline shortfall rejection in the UI — comparable to FP3 with a guard rule.
Mostly a read/aggregation slice: SKU detail view listing multiple location rows; reuses FP1 persistence with no new write path.
